meta.title: The Reckoning
meta.notes: Import after act2_00_meta.json. Act III branches based on the player's choice at the end of Act II. Four entry points: act3_ch1_new_ashenveld, act3_ch1_leaving, act3_ch1_staying_briefly, act3_ch1_alone_in_ashenveld. Each leads to different endings.

stayed_in_ashenveld.description: Player and missing person both stay. The rebuilding arc. Ends with the Warden Stays ending family.

left_with_missing.description: Player leaves Ashenveld with the missing person. The Warden Escapes ending family.

sent_missing_ahead.description: Player stays briefly to finish work, then follows. Hybrid arc.

stayed_alone.description: Player stays without the missing person. The most ambiguous arc.

ending_stays_together.title: The Warden Stays
ending_stays_together.description: The player and their missing person stay in Ashenveld together. The Rootless camp becomes a lasting institution, the curse goes back over the years, and Ashenveld slowly rebuilds. The ending is quiet and particular: one morning some years later, and the ordinary run of a life made in a hard place with somebody worth staying for.

ending_alone_legend.title: The Warden Becomes a Legend
ending_alone_legend.description: The player stays in Ashenveld alone and becomes, over the years, the person the region forms itself round. Not a hero, but a fixture, somebody whose being there makes the difference between Ashenveld lasting and not. The missing person is spoken of but not present. The ending is sad and proud in equal measure.

ending_escape_together.title: The Warden Escapes
ending_escape_together.description: The player leaves Ashenveld with their missing person. The ending is left open on purpose: what they made between them in the ruins has no name yet. They are somewhere else, somewhere ordinary, and the ordinary is both a relief and a question.

ending_stays_rootless.title: The Warden of Ashenveld
ending_stays_rootless.description: The player stays on the Rootless side. The camp grows into a real institution. The ending shows Ashenveld years later, rebuilt, not wholly healed, but able to go on. The player is one of the people whatever Ashenveld becomes was built on.

ending_stays_compact.title: The Compact's Warden
ending_stays_compact.description: The player stays on the Compact side. Ashenveld is made steady, efficiently. The player becomes the regional authority's chief man or woman on the spot, and order comes back. What that order costs shows in what becomes of the Rootless camp: smaller, managed, less its own. The ending is not a triumph. It works.

ending_warden_dies.title: What Remains
ending_warden_dies.description: The player dies in Ashenveld. It is not dramatic. It is the cost of a choice made in Act III. The ending is told by the people who are left: what they remember, and what the player's being there made possible that would never have been possible otherwise.

ending_secret.title: The Account
ending_secret.description: Opened only if the player has brought out the hidden truth of all three factions, is as close as possible to their missing person, and chose to stay. The player publishes a full account of what happened in Ashenveld: what the Compact was doing, what Seriva did, and what the Covenant's purification would have cost. No faction wins, and Ashenveld breaks up into separate settlements. It is the most hopeful ending, and the loneliest.

ashenveld_years_later.name: Ashenveld, some years later
ashenveld_years_later.description: The endings take place in Ashenveld as it has become over time. How it stands depends on the choices made. Under the Compact it is orderly and smaller; under the Rootless it is less orderly and more alive; left by both, it is still mending slowly in its own way.
ashenveld_years_later.note: This location is rendered differently based on faction flags.

west_road_leaving.name: The West Road
west_road_leaving.description: The road that goes away from Ashenveld. Ordinary trees. Ordinary weather.
